content.text: @sue/board-mind provides native Mind Cells, validation, tree transactions and layouts. Domain toolbars and property panels live in @sue/board-react-mind; @sue/verd-board-ui composes them into the product.

Nine layouts, Tab/Enter topic creation, deletion, reparenting and sibling ordering, collapse, clipboard identity remapping, images and emoji, independent rich-text notes, adjustable summary ranges, file-level color schemes and automatic content sizing. Transactions preserve root protection, branch ordering, relationship closure and summary endpoints.

@sue/board-react-mind composes engine behavior, layouts, rendering, toolbars and property panels through createMindUIPlugin. Embedded and detail views share one FrameCanvas and the same source content. The former domain Canvas and MindElement APIs remain removed; legacy conversion stays in the application-private migration boundary.

Use createMindPlugin() with createCellRegistry({plugins}) for engine-only calls. A complete editor composes createMindUIPlugin() with FrameEditor and imports board-react/style.css plus board-react-mind/style.css. The lower-level createMindFrameExtensions(registry) requires an already installed Mind engine plugin; it does not install utilities implicitly.

Read packages/engine/mind/package.json for direct dependencies. The core model uses @sue/board-core, @sue/board-common and @sue/board-layouts. Do not rebuild the former component or document reducer layer.

Mind Engine Overview
@sue/board-mind provides native Mind Cells, validation, tree transactions and layouts. Domain toolbars and property panels live in @sue/board-react-mind; @sue/verd-board-ui composes them into the product.
Features
Nine layouts, Tab/Enter topic creation, deletion, reparenting and sibling ordering, collapse, clipboard identity remapping, images and emoji, independent rich-text notes, adjustable summary ranges, file-level color schemes and automatic content sizing. Transactions preserve root protection, branch ordering, relationship closure and summary endpoints.
@sue/board-react-mind composes engine behavior, layouts, rendering, toolbars and property panels through createMindUIPlugin. Embedded and detail views share one FrameCanvas and the same source content. The former domain Canvas and MindElement APIs remain removed; legacy conversion stays in the application-private migration boundary.
Dependencies and Usage
Use createMindPlugin() with createCellRegistry({plugins}) for engine-only calls. A complete editor composes createMindUIPlugin() with FrameEditor and imports board-react/style.css plus board-react-mind/style.css. The lower-level createMindFrameExtensions(registry) requires an already installed Mind engine plugin; it does not install utilities implicitly.
Read packages/engine/mind/package.json for direct dependencies. The core model uses @sue/board-core, @sue/board-common and @sue/board-layouts. Do not rebuild the former component or document reducer layer.
